eco.title: One Ecosystem. Four Connected Layers.
eco.subtitle: Explore how the Network, FIT Token, Gift and DAO work together within the Fly Infinity platform.
eco.networkText: Coordinates network activity and routes eligible FIT purchase requests.
eco.fitText: A BNB Smart Chain token whose base price is calculated from DAI reserve and FIT supply.
eco.giftText: A dedicated smart-contract layer for the platform's gift mechanisms.
eco.daoText: A proposal, voting and execution framework defined by the DAO contract.
eco.engineTitle: How the FIT Price Model Works
eco.reserveText: The DAI held by the FIT token contract is the reserve input used by the on-chain price function.
eco.supplyText: The contract reads the current FIT total supply as the denominator of its price calculation.
eco.priceText: The public Price() function calculates the base price directly from those two values.
eco.formula: FIT Price = DAI Reserve ÷ FIT Total Supply
eco.historyIntro: A summary of the historical daily records currently published with this website.
eco.historyNote: These figures describe the records in price-history.json, not a guarantee of future price behavior. The file contains dated observations and may not include every calendar day.
eco.contractText: Core token functions and the pricing formula can be reviewed in the published Solidity source and checked against on-chain contract activity.
eco.governanceText: The current DAO contract restricts proposal creation to the founder and voting to networkers; proposal execution follows the rules encoded in the public contract.
eco.privacyText: Review the website privacy policy to understand what local preferences and information are handled by the site.
